decisions_requested.statement: Approve the six-mode drill cycle for OPI 3 and 4 in slots 013-024, reusing the P01 pedagogical pattern without declaring it a universal Activation grammar.
Approve slots 013-018 as drills of the validated contextual age/cardinal card EN KU SARASALA KE, preserving SARASALA=WATCH and numeral primitives=CANDIDATE.
Approve slots 019-024 as drills of EN SARADAYA KUVAN KE with bare [PLACE] response, preserving SARADAYA=FROZEN and KUVAN=CANDIDATE.
Approve TRACE_GIDS for these drills as structural G-ID training only, with Candidate D visuals remaining PREPRODUCTION_NOT_OFFICIAL.
Confirm P02 is new SimpleWay HNK v1.1 authorship derived from validated OPI and not reconstruction of the missing historical Activation payload.

explicit_non_effects: Does not create new HNK lexical forms.
Does not promote SARASALA, KUVAN or numeral primitives.
Does not grant global number, age or locative grammar.
Does not make Candidate D drawings official visual canon.
Does not promote any Activation slot to FROZEN.
application_rule: Do not transition Activation P02 to VALIDATED until all five scoped decisions are explicitly approved.
